title: Culligan Group (Culligan) - Waterlogic Group Holdings Limited (Waterlogic)

timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a section 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.

body_sections.Summary: Culligan is controlled by Osmosis Buyer Limited ( Osmosis ). Culligan is headquartered is the USA and operates a global water systems treatment company. In Australia, Culligan owns the Zip brand, which manufactures and supplies multi-functional taps, bottle-free coolers, wall mounted boilers, bubblers and other drinking water solutions. Firewall Holding S.À R.L. ( Firewall ) is the holding company of Waterlogic Group Holdings Limited ( Waterlogic ).  Waterlogic is headquartered in the UK and operates in various countries. In Australia, Waterlogic supplies water products and services through Australian subsidiaries, including: Billi Australia Pty Ltd ( Billi business ) manufactures, supplies and services multi-functional taps; and Waterlogic Australia Holdings Pty Ltd which supplies rentals and servicing of bottle-free coolers, wall mounted boilers, bubblers and other drinking water products. On 21 December 2021, Osmosis entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of the shares in Firewall. The ACCC commenced its public review on 4 March 2022. On 19 May 2022, the ACCC decided to not oppose Culligan’s proposed acquisition of Waterlogic, subject to the ACCC accepting a court-enforceable undertaking from Osmosis to divest the Billi business.
